items.label: Insulated Lunch Compartment & Leakproof
items.value: The teacher tote bag features a lunch compartment on the side that can keep food warm for up to 4 hours and cold drinks for up to 6 hours. The high-quality insulated layer of the lunch compartment keeps the food fresh and warm at work, and is easy to clean. Whether it’s drinks or food scraps accidentally spilled, wipe with a wet cloth. It could accommodate 6*250ml cans. Lunch tote bag is ideal for nurse, teacher, office worker carrying lunch to work.

items.label: Large Capacity & Multiple Pockets
items.value: The laptop bag for women with over 15 pockets can easily hold all your daily necessities. The main compartment has a padded sleeve for 15.6" laptop & 12.9" iPad, plus 6 open slots and an insulated bottle pocket. The dual-layer front organizer offers quick access- the outer layer has a flip-top and zippered pocket, and the inner layer contains 1 open pocket, 4 elastic loops, and 1 mesh pocket. Side lunch pocket keeps food fresh; A back pocket for documents.

items.label: Durable & Water-Resistant
items.value: The laptop lunch bag for women is made of high-quality, water- and scratch-resistant polyester fabric. It features smooth zippers, a sturdy handle, and adjustable padded shoulder straps. The reliable zippers and reinforced stitching enhance the bag's durability. This laptop bag keeps your computer stable and secure, and it includes a convenient lunch compartment for your lunch.

items.label: Multiple Ways to Carry
items.value: With a comfortable shoulder strap and sturdy handles, you can carry this work bags as a shoulder bag, office bag, or crossbody bag. It's perfect for commuting, work, and weekend travel. The back luggage strap slides over your suitcase handle, making this bag ideal for business trips and travel. It fits easily in overhead bins and under the seat, perfect for frequent flyers.

items: Ideal Gift for Women：This laptop tote bag combines elegant appearance with practical design. Large capacity and multiple storage make it a great choice to use as a teacher bag, nursing bag, professional work bag, business travel bag or weekend getaway carry-on bag. Perfect for commuting teachers, tutors, nurses, business ladies, etc. An ideal gift for teachers, nurses and parents for any holiday, birthday or anniversary. Also an ideal teacher appreciation gift.

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Machine wash cold, tumble dry low
